usedFor: Yousign tracks signature requests and signers, and Google Docs gets the outcome through “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “Signer Request Done” in Yousign, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: A finished signature request is recorded in a Doc tab, so the result sits where the team already reads.

watchOut: “New Contact” polls on a schedule while “Contact Created” is pushed, so choose the second to avoid delay.
